vulnerability_list.description: The transfer function allows an arbitrary amount of ERC20 tokens to be transfered directly to the contract. This could be used as a method to bypass the crowdsale and transfer tokens to the owner. Furthermore, if the contract does not implement a transfer function, an attacker could use the transfer method of the ERC20 token to transfer the tokens from this contract to the attacker's address. This would benefit the attacker significantly as he/she would have the tokens to further exploit other vulnerabilities in the smart contract.
